title: Normal Line to a Spherical Level Surface
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find parametric equations for the normal line to the sphere x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 14 at the point P(1, 2, 3).

steps.title: Compute Gradient Normal Vector
steps.mathExpression: F(x, y, z) = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 - 14 \implies \nabla F(1, 2, 3) = \langle 2, 4, 6 \rangle = 2\langle 1, 2, 3 \rangle
steps.explanation: The gradient is normal to the sphere at P.

steps.title: Write Parametric Equations of Normal Line
steps.explanation: Use simplified direction vector <1, 2, 3> passing through point (1, 2, 3).
